events.summary: Sweep best of 6: 4.1 ± 0.9 vs 0.0 ± 0.0 for current practice (visits/week by residents who can't make current hours). SW Sweep best of 6 wins because it delivers 4.1 ± 0.9 visits/week from residents who cannot make current hours, versus 0.0 ± 0.0 under current practice, and it also beats the other tested options (next best was 3.3 ± 1.4). It does so with 88 staff h/wk, the same as current practice, while the other new schedules use 96 staff h/wk.
events.assumptions: This result depends on the synthetic resident schedules, arrival rates, and word-of-mouth rates used in the model; it also assumes the held-out scenarios are representative of future demand patterns.
events.pilot: Run a 6-week pilot of Thu 13:00-21:00 once per week alongside current hours, and measure weekly visits by residents who cannot make the usual hours, total staff hours, and any change in overall library visits. Compare against a matched baseline period before expanding.
